11.comment: No Figma counterpart - kept as placeholder

14.comment: Section spacing. Fills the 48 -> 64 jump. | 56px in Figma (space.56)

24.comment: Largest layout gap. Page section separation. | 96px in Figma (space.96)

0.5.comment: SUB-GRID (2px). Dense controls only. Required by size/pill-xs (16 tall, 12px text = 2px padding). Not general-purpose spacing. | 2px in Figma (space.2)

1.5.comment: SUB-GRID (6px). Dense controls only. Required by size/control-sm (28 tall, 14px/1.25 text = 6px padding). | 6px in Figma (space.6)

2.5.comment: SUB-GRID (10px). Dense controls only. Required by size/control-xl (40 tall, 16px/1.25 text = 10px padding). | 10px in Figma (space.10)

thick.comment: Emphasised border — 1.5px. Used where a 1px line reads too faint against a tint.

icon.comment: Icon vector stroke. 1.25 is the value the icon set was drawn at — tokenised rather than redrawn.

overlay.comment: Blanket / scrim. Must sit BELOW the modal it dims.

raised.comment: Hover-lifted cards, focused input above siblings.

sticky.comment: Sticky page header, sticky table header, toolbar.

dropdown.comment: Menu, ListBox, Select/ComboBox popup, Autocomplete results.

popover.comment: Popover — can open from inside a modal.

toast.comment: Toast notifications. Above modals so they are never buried.

sm.comment: Small radius — 4px. Even values only across the scale; radius/full stays 999 for pills. | 4px in Figma

md.comment: Default radius. Buttons, inputs, badges. | 8px in Figma

xl.comment: Modals, drawers, large surfaces. | 16px in Figma

xxl.comment: Hero panels, feature cards. | 20px in Figma

xxxl.comment: Largest rounding before full. | 24px in Figma

sans.comment: The only typeface in the system.

mono.comment: Monospace family. Code blocks, IDs, numeric tables where digits must align. Pairs with font/family/sans (Roboto).

display.comment: Display heading size. Sits above xxxl (24); the only step beyond the 10–24 ladder. | 28px in Figma

regular.comment: CSS numeric weight for developer handoff.

medium.comment: CSS numeric weight for developer handoff.

semibold.comment: CSS numeric weight for developer handoff.

bold.comment: CSS numeric weight for developer handoff.

offset-x.comment: Shadow offsetX for elevation/xl. Always 0 - present so elevation.xl exports as a complete shadow object rather than a partial one.

offset-y.comment: Y offset for elevation/xl. Full-screen overlays, command palette.

spread.comment: Shadow spread for elevation/xl. Always 0 - present so elevation.xl exports as a complete shadow object rather than a partial one.

offset-x.comment: Shadow offsetX for elevation/sm. Always 0 - present so elevation.sm exports as a complete shadow object rather than a partial one.

offset-y.comment: Y offset for elevation/sm. Resting cards, inputs.

spread.comment: Shadow spread for elevation/sm. Always 0 - present so elevation.sm exports as a complete shadow object rather than a partial one.

offset-x.comment: Shadow offsetX for elevation/md. Always 0 - present so elevation.md exports as a complete shadow object rather than a partial one.

offset-y.comment: Y offset for elevation/md. Dropdowns, popovers.

spread.comment: Shadow spread for elevation/md. Always 0 - present so elevation.md exports as a complete shadow object rather than a partial one.

offset-x.comment: Shadow offsetX for elevation/lg. Always 0 - present so elevation.lg exports as a complete shadow object rather than a partial one.

offset-y.comment: Y offset for elevation/lg. Modals, drawers.

spread.comment: Shadow spread for elevation/lg. Always 0 - present so elevation.lg exports as a complete shadow object rather than a partial one.

slow.comment: Deliberate transitions: modal / drawer enter, page transitions. 300ms. Completes the ramp instant(100) > fast(150) > normal(200) > slow(300).

standard.comment: General-purpose curve for on-screen state changes: hover, colour, size. Accelerates then decelerates.

enter.comment: Decelerate. For elements ENTERING the screen (menu open, toast in, modal in). Fast start, soft landing.

exit.comment: Accelerate. For elements LEAVING the screen (menu close, toast out). Slow start, quick departure.

linear.comment: No easing. Required for continuous motion: Spinner rotation, Meter / Progress Tracker fill, Skeleton shimmer.

ring-width.comment: Focus ring thickness (3px). Renamed from border/focus, which collided on export with the Semantic COLOR border/focus.

ring-offset.comment: Gap between the component edge and the focus ring, so the ring stays visible on filled buttons. WCAG 2.2 SC 2.4.13.

control-md.comment: Default control height. 32 with 14px/1.25 text = 8px vertical padding (space/8), fully on grid. | 32px in Figma

pill-xs.comment: Status Pill control height — XS. 4px scale. | 16px in Figma

pill-md.comment: Status Pill control height — MD. 4px scale. | 24px in Figma

pill-lg.comment: Status Pill control height — LG. 4px scale. | 28px in Figma

pill-xl.comment: Status Pill control height — XL. 4px scale. | 32px in Figma

switch-track-hm.comment: Mobile switch track height. Was 0, which made the mobile switch invisible. 36x20 pairs with switch-track-wm. | 20px in Figma

pill-sm.comment: Status Pill control height — S. 4px scale. | 20px in Figma

dot-md.comment: Diameter of a standalone status dot (dot-only Badge). | 12px in Figma

icon-xxl.comment: Icon ramp rung between 24 and 32. Added so Platform Mobile can alias rather than hard-code 28. | 28px in Figma

tablet.comment: Lower bound of the Tablet range (768–1023). Below this: Mobile — single column, stacked-card tables, full-screen sheets. Ratified Jul 2026 from the §05 working table. | 768px in Figma

laptop.comment: Lower bound of the Laptop range (1024–1279). Nav collapses to the 64px rail; detail panel becomes overlay. Ratified Jul 2026 from the §05 working table. | 1024px in Figma

desktop.comment: Lower bound of the Desktop range (1280–1599) — the design target. Nav expanded, detail panel open, 12 columns. Ratified Jul 2026 from the §05 working table. | 1280px in Figma

wide.comment: Lower bound of the Wide range (≥1600) — control room and supervisor displays. Ratified Jul 2026 from the §05 working table. | 1600px in Figma

mobile.comment: Mobile baseline width. The scale had no entry below tablet(768), so mobile-first min-width queries had no anchor. | 360px in Figma

standard.comment: Lower bound of the Tablet range (768–1023). Below this: Mobile — single column, stacked-card tables, full-screen sheets. Ratified Jul 2026 from the §05 working table.

overlay.comment: Scrim behind Modal, Drawer and Blanket. Added Jul 2026 to close the layering gap.
